sort_by.description:
Sort by options for packs for app.

- `title`: sort by the title of the pack.
- `created_at`: sort by when the pack is created.
- `total_members`: sort by the amount of members in the pack.
- `total_treets`: sort by the amount of treets in the pack.
- `price`: sort by the price of the pack.
- `join_date`: sort by when the user joined the pack.
sort_by.title: AppPackSortBy

search.description: Filter by title of pack. If not given, no filter is applied.
search.title: Search

is_member.description: If true, only returns packs that the user is a member of. If false, only returns packs that the user is not a member of. If not given, all packs are returned.
is_member.title: Is Member

is_member_first.description: If true, will show packs where current user is member first. If false, will show packs where current user is not member first. The sort_by will be applied to the packs where member and the packs where member separately. If not given, will only follow sort_by.
is_member_first.title: Is Member First

category_id.description: ID of category to fetch treets with.
category_id.title: Category Id

embed_total_members.description: Amount of members in group. Must be true when sorting by it.
embed_total_members.title: Embed Total Members

embed_subscription_data.description: Embed subscription data if pack require subscriptions. Otherwise, for free or one-time packs, it will be null.
embed_subscription_data.title: Embed Subscription Data
